provenance.warning: NOT part of the real IEEE case30 topology. Hand-picked hypothetical lines for the CAS-INT-004 'add line' control; any resemblance to a real planned line is coincidental.
provenance.rationale: Bus pairs with no direct line in case30. x_pu and rating_mw are chosen in the range of nearby existing lines (x 0.2-0.5 pu, 16-65 MW); x_pu is on sn_mva=100 like case30 lines.
provenance.idx_convention: idx = 41 + candidate position, continuing case30 line idx 0..40; 'added_lines' scenario param lists candidate positions (0-based)
